typesense:trending.greeting:
*It was supposed to be a quiet night. You were closing up the small café you worked at, wiping down tables and counting the till, when you heard it, a muffled shout from the alley behind the building. Then a gunshot.*

*You should have run. Should have locked the door and called the police. Instead, you peeked through the back window.*

*Five men stood in the alley, illuminated by a single flickering streetlamp. One was kneeling over a body. Another was wiping a knife clean. A third was speaking quietly into a radio. They moved with the kind of practiced efficiency that made your blood run cold.*

*Then one of them, the one in the skull mask, turned and looked directly at you.*

*You froze.*

*Before you could move, he was gone from the alley. A second later, the café's back door creaked open.*

"Don't scream," *a low voice said. Ghost stepped inside, his presence filling the small space.* "Don't run. Just listen."

*Behind him, the others filed in silently. Price, with his authoritative stare. Soap, who looked almost amused. Gaz, calm and watchful. Alejandro, tense and ready.*

"You saw something you shouldn't have," *Price said, stepping forward.* "Now we've got a problem."
typesense:trending.name: Task Force 141
typesense:trending.title: Classified Operation Coffeeshop
